proposals.evidence: Full CDIAL section 2 *raśuna/rasuna/rasōna explicitly gives Bengali rasun, Oriya rasuṇa, Bihari rasun/rassun and Hindi rasun, distinct from the l-initial section. Survey r-initial garlic forms follow this branch, retaining vowel and rhotic/nasal notation; local IA transmission is unresolved. Exact response: rusun.
